decisions.reason: As a close-to-core upholstery fabric with prior dedicated support, it remains a relatively low-cost option and there is still not enough negative evidence to justify withdrawal.
Its flame-retardant functionality fits the firm's contract and hospitality strengths, so the strategic upside still outweighs the modest cost of keeping it in the range.
We would keep it for now because it extends the decorative collection at low incremental cost, although its niche wool-blend profile and weaker visibility leave it close to the cut line.

After two selling seasons, its niche semi-transparent wool bouclé leno position, limited website prominence and weaker fit with the firm's simplification and sustainability direction make further retention hard to justify.
As a 2024 launch with its own page and a clear link to both upholstery and curtain applications, it is still an early-stage option whose market potential has not yet been fully revealed.
